in_sanskrit.name: Bilu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord Shiva
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bilu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Bilu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'bilva' which means 'Lord Shiva'. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is known to be the destroyer and the transformer of the universe. The Bilva leaf is considered sacred and is often used in worship.
